title: Huawei SmartWatch as a collector
symptom: The user reports that the Huawei SmartWatch does not work as a standalone collector for xDrip+ with the G5 sensor, despite trying various debug settings.
cause: The thread indicates that the G5 BT settings need to be set on the watch itself, not on the phone, and that the watch may require ROM patches to work correctly with the G5.
fix: The fix is to apply patches to the Huawei watch's ROM as described in the provided 'care pack' and PDF guide, which makes the watch work correctly with the G5.
evidence_quote: The Huawei watch is now supported but you will need to apply patches to its rom to make it work correctly. First step is to download the "care pack" I have provided and look at the PDF guide for instructions of how to do it.
